title: Learned content-addressed retrieval without explicit entity IDs
question: Can the multimodal state retrieve the correct observed entity from an episode-local random address key when observation order and target slot are randomized, without receiving an explicit entity ID?
hypothesis: The learned-address PLM will recover the target observation and solve the held-out q2 task without explicit entity IDs.

protocol.temporal_carry: disabled for causal isolation; C18 showed it is not load-bearing on E2E-008

held_constant: same collision-free text/image/audio payload generator family as E2E-008
same five seeds, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay and 300-step budget
same hidden_dim=64 multimodal encoders and fixed Boolean execution library
operator ID remains explicit so this lane tests addressing only
each episode has exactly three observations, each with an independent random address key
address keys are independent of payload bits and modality encodings
observation order is shuffled per episode
q2 target slot is exactly balanced across the three storage slots over the 600 evaluation episodes
q1 and q2 target entities are distinct
no post-run model selection or tuning
leakage_rules: entity ID is absent from all model inputs
query contains only the target address key, bit indices, operator and answer-free fields
address key is independent of payload, operator and answer
evaluation address keys are regenerated after training from a separate RNG namespace
training/evaluation semantic overlap must be zero including address keys and payloads
fixed observation position cannot identify q2 target; q2 target slot is balanced and observation order randomized
oracle address is evaluation-only and is not used for training
no answer, correctness flag, verifier target or entity ID enters the addressing module
the benchmark generator hash is pinned to this contract and the E2E-008 generator lineage

arms.name: learned_address
arms.intervention: retrieve by learned similarity between query address key and stored episode-local keys

arms.name: oracle_address
arms.intervention: retrieve the known target slot directly using hidden benchmark slot identity

arms.name: corrupted_address
arms.intervention: replace q2 address with another observed entity's key while preserving q2 payload target and label

arms.name: shuffle_observation_order
arms.intervention: permute the storage order while preserving all keys and payloads

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; learned-address q2 mean >=0.80; every seed >=0.40; address-selection mean >=0.90; every seed >=0.80; oracle-address q2 mean >=0.80; learned-versus-oracle mean gap <=0.10
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that learned content addressing can replace explicit entity IDs on the registered synthetic multimodal task
decision_rule.does_not_license: semantic addressing, open-world retrieval, learned operator discovery, temporal memory necessity, real-world multimodal understanding, scaling

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but any registered primary/mechanism threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: the learned-address capability criterion is not established on this benchmark
decision_rule.does_not_license: general impossibility of learned addressing or PLM

interpretation_order: oracle upper bound and action-decision consistency
